title: SB93 (2025-2026 Regular): Weapons: robotic devices.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk dataset (gun-policy Stage 5 LegiScan check, California); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official leginfo.legislature.ca.gov text (Amended 2025-04-03, via LegiScan getBillText)
provenance.note: Amended 2025-04-03 (last version; no floor vote). The amendment widens 'weapon' to cover firearms and other deadly weapons and narrows the device list. Exemptions in (d) (government-use developers, robot competitions, blank-firing props, academic research, government agents) not quoted except (d)(2)(B).

operative_text:
Section 18722 (Penal Code): (3) “Weapon” means a firearm or other deadly weapon, or a device specifically designed to cause incapacitation, including, but not limited to, a stun gun, a chemical agent, or a kinetic energy projectile.
Section 18722 (Penal Code): (b) It shall be unlawful for a person to operate a robotic device equipped or mounted with a weapon.
Section 18722 (Penal Code): (c) A violation of this section is an infraction punishable by a fine of at least one hundred dollars ($100) but not more than two thousand dollars ($2,000).
Section 18722 (Penal Code): (B) This paragraph does not allow the equipping or mounting of any firearm to a robotic device.
